embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: GeoWM: Efficient Direct World Modeling in Explicit Geometry
fields.value: Huawei Noah's Ark Lab, Canada (flag) — Modeling 3D scene geometry and its evolution over time is central to autonomous driving and robotics, but the common world-model paradigm of predicting future images or latent representations and then recovering geometry does not explicitly model geometric structure and relies on recursive rollouts

fields.name: Considering Context: When World Models Need Context Encoders
fields.value: Microsoft; Sara Karimi also lists KTH Royal Institute of Technology) — Model-based reinforcement learning commonly assumes an agent cannot infer the latent context governing environment dynamics from its own experience, so systems supply that context externally (e.g., to a world model like DreamerV3).

fields.name: SteadySplats: Resampling of Low-Variance Gaussians for High-Fidelity Stochastic Rendering
fields.value: NVIDIA; Google DeepMind — The paper proposes SteadySplats, a method for high-fidelity stochastic order-independent-transparency rendering of 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, combining a training-time color-variance regularizer with inference-time history-based spatial resampling and temporal resampling for camera-motion coheren

fields.name: PixReenact: Pixel-Conditioned Causal Video Diffusion for Streaming Head-Avatar Reenactment
fields.value: NVIDIA — PixReenact is a streaming system that animates a reference face using a live driving video, operating directly on encoded image frames rather than specialized identity/motion features extracted by external models (which the authors argue inherits those extractors' errors).

fields.name: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
fields.value: Sber; individual per-author institution tags were not resolvable from the retrieved text beyond the group-level attribution — Kandinsky 6.0 Video introduces two diffusion foundation models — Lite (3B parameters) and Pro (29B parameters) — for synchronized video and audio generation, producing 5-second clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio including lip-sync across multiple generation modes.

fields.name: FLEX-WAM: Flexible Block-Causal World-Action Models for Long-Horizon Imagination and Planning
fields.value: NVIDIA — FLEX-WAM is a flexible block-causal world-action model that predicts action-conditioned futures, generates feasible actions, and supports planning in imagination, while handling variable-length context and stable long multi-step autoregressive rollouts.

fields.name: CreativeFlow: A One-to-Many Analogical Relation Transfer Method for 3D Asset Generation
fields.value: Adobe Research — The paper presents CreativeFlow, an analogical generation framework inspired by cognitive science that explicitly models analogical divergent thinking to counter creative homogenization in text-to-3D pipelines.

fields.name: CleanMDM: Clean Motion Diffusion Model for Multimodal Motion Cleanup
fields.value: Alibaba — CleanMDM is a unified Clean Motion Diffusion Model that formulates motion-capture cleanup — removing jitter, missing segments, drift and contact artifacts — as masked conditional generation, accepting combinations of noisy 3D motion, sparse 2D/3D keyframes and text as plug-and-play conditions.

fields.name: Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spatiotemporal Priors and Generative Assistance
fields.value: JD.com — The paper presents a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework built for the Sparse-View Track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Volumetric Video Challenge, which requires dynamic scene reconstruction from only six wide-baseline cameras.

fields.name: Neuroll: Real-Time Neural Strand-Based Hair Simulation via Simulator-in-the-Loop Unrolling
fields.value: Meta; NVIDIA — The paper presents Neuroll, a neural time integrator for strand-based hair simulation designed to mirror the input-output formulation of classical time integrators (previous hair states, material stiffness, collision geometry).

fields.name: Lollypop: Camera-to-Motion-Capture Calibration Verification with a Reference Target
fields.value: Meta — The paper introduces Lollypop, a fiducial-mocap reference target that independently verifies camera-to-motion-capture (mocap) calibration.

fields.name: DistScene: Object-to-Scene Distillation for 3D Scene Generation
fields.value: TeleAI / China Telecom; other authors: HKUST. **FLAG: borderline** — DistScene generates compositional 3D scenes from a single image by jointly producing separate environment and object components in a unified coordinate system, then refining objects and distilling object-level generative priors into the scene.

fields.name: CurveCodec 2: Skeleton-agnostic animation compression with a learned entropy model
fields.value: Adobe Research — The paper presents CurveCodec 2, a skeleton-agnostic skeletal-motion compression codec that asks which part of a production codec a learned model should take over, building on the authors' earlier CurveCodec.

fields.name: UniBRep: Learning Unified Geometry and Topology for Image-conditioned B-Rep Generation
fields.value: Amazon; other authors are University of Maryland, College Park — UniBRep is a geometry-first framework that adapts a pretrained image-to-3D model to generate CAD B-Rep (boundary representation) solids from a single image.

fields.name: SUAVE: Unified Video-Action Models via Masked Diffusion
fields.value: Toyota Research Institute — The paper presents SUAVE, a unified video-action model in which a masked diffusion transformer generates video and robot actions conditioned on language, with all three modalities represented as discrete tokens in one shared sequence.
